scenes.heading: End ten minutes early and write the notes

sents.d: End ten minutes early and write the notes
Notes written hours later get vague and start blending clients together.
Hours later you have a line about the team issue and no idea whose team.
That vagueness shows up in their next session.

scenes.heading: Book the gap, then use it

sents.d: End ten minutes before the hour, or let your booking tool add the buffer for you.
Use that time only for notes, with your template already open.

take: Build a ten-minute notes gap into every booking.
